notes.title: Important Update: Crazy Shipping Pricing Change
notes.notes: [p][b]Captains,[/b][/p][p]After careful consideration I'm making an important change to Crazy Shipping's business model.[/p][p]The free-to-play model hasn't provided the sustainable revenue needed to fund the updates I want to make and that you deserve. By moving to a premium model I can focus on creating better ships, stations, storylines, and features without freemium mechanics being a consideration.[/p][h3]What's Changing[/h3][p]Effective [b]July 5th 2025[/b], Crazy Shipping will move from free-to-play to a [b]$4.99 USD[/b] purchase price. This change allows me to invest more resources into content updates, story campaigns and expanded gameplay systems to keep the game fun into the future.[/p][h3]What This Means for You[/h3][p][b]Current Players[/b][/p][p]If you already have Crazy Shipping in your Steam library, nothing changes. You keep the game forever and get all updates at no additional cost.[/p][p][b]Progression[/b][/p][p]Voidium will be paid for 30% of jobs instead of 10%, making it generally 3x more available and allow faster in-game progression.[/p][p][b]Premium Currency[/b][/p][p]Optional purchases remain available for players who want to progress faster or support ongoing development.[/p][h3]Going Forwards[/h3][p]I believe a small upfront investment creates a better relationship between me and players, allowing me to build the deep, engaging, cute space logistics experience you've been asking for.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support as we chart this new course together.[/p][p]Adam[/p][p]P.S. Make sure to keep a lookout for the official Crazy Shipping OST coming soon from [url="https://linktr.ee/datreya"]Datreya[/url]![/p]

notes.title: Crazy Shipping is launching now! 🐱🚀🌌
notes.notes:
Launch your career as an interstellar shipping magnate with an army of enterprising cat pilots! Start with a small fleet of basic ships and build your way to commanding massive cargo haulers across a solar system full of opportunities (and occasional space whales).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227373/8776f3989dbf51eaa18e66bd2cd20dab124c3c9f.png[/img]

[h3]🚀 KEY FEATURES[/h3]

- Manage a growing fleet of 19 unique ship types, from nimble single-cargo vessels to massive 17-slot haulers
- Run legitimate deliveries or spice things up with "hot" cargo for bigger profits
- React to dynamic events like solar flares, pirate raids, and mysterious space whales
- Balance station alert levels - higher risk means higher rewards
- Upgrade your ships and stations to improve efficiency and reduce risks
- Free-to-play with all ships and features available through gameplay
- Customize your ships with various paint schemes and patterns

Begin with 4 ships and 3 stations, then expand your operations across unique locations like the bustling Neon Haven, mysterious Olympus Labs, or the remote Eris Terminal.

Your first delivery awaits, captain! 🐱‍🚀
